layer1.name: Ghost
layer1.one_liner: An open-source publishing platform for professional writers.
layer1.description: A stripped-down alternative to general-purpose CMS software, focused only on publishing and newsletters. Open source, with paid managed hosting. Entering a category dominated by an incumbent with overwhelming market share.
layer1.outcome_note: Independent and profitable. Publishes its annual run rate publicly: $10,947,413 at the time of retrieval.

sources.note: Public ARR figure on the company about page
